Figure 1: An overview of the SkillChain three-stage framework. (a) Skill Creator bootstraps Skills from task specifications and user trajectories via an engineer loop, then gates quality through human reflection before deployment. (b) Route Optimizer continuously mines routing failures in production and applies update/merge/discard operations to keep Skill Description boundaries aligned with real traffic. (c) Body Refiner evaluates responses through a dual-path pipeline and aggregates cross-sample signals to drive iterative Skill Body refinement.
